item.title: Urgent Update: Litter Bin Not Emptied for Over a Week – Overflowing Rubbish Requires Immediate Attention, 24th August
item.description:
I am writing to provide an update regarding this ongoing issue, as the problem has not been resolved. The litter bin in the alleyway adjacent to 79 King Hall Road has now apparently not been checked or emptied for over a week. As a result, rubbish is overflowing from the bin and litter is now scattered throughout the surrounding area. The situation has significantly worsened and requires urgent attention. The accumulation of waste is creating a health and safety concern, attracting vermin, and making the alleyway unpleasant for residents and pedestrians. As the bin continues to overflow and litter remains spread across the area, I do not consider this issue to have been fixed. I would be grateful if a waste collection team could attend as soon as possible to clear the rubbish and empty the bin. Please could this matter be treated as a priority and investigated urgently. Thank you for your assistance, and I look forward to receiving an update.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Kings Hall Road, Penge, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
